changes: Retained the v1.0.149 Accounts, Income and Transactions report improvements.
Omitted unchanged v1.0.148 files from this package; the corrected updater also skips files already matching the package.
Added bounded retries for temporary access-denied errors during program replacement and settings saves; permanent denials still stop safely.
Verified program backups and replacements; rollback attempts every replaced file and identifies any restoration failures and backup location.
Removed the unconditional restoration-success message and automatic app restart after failed installation.
Included a standalone repair installer to install the corrected updater without opening the app. Household databases, profiles, attachments and testing edits are excluded.
